findings.title: Supplier rebate shortfall
findings.explanation: Q1 eligible spend reached the 6% rebate tier. Expected rebate was $36,720; only $24,480 was credited.
findings.action: Request the remaining $12,240 supplier rebate credit.

findings.title: Purchase price variance
findings.explanation: Approved PO value was $40,293. Supplier invoice value was $43,668.
findings.action: Request correction or credit for the $3,375 variance.

findings.title: Duplicate economic invoice
findings.explanation: Two submitted invoices represent the same supplier, item, quantity, rate and $9,750 economic event under different references.
findings.action: Verify duplicate status and request reversal/credit of $9,750.

findings.title: Approved credit missing from ledger
findings.explanation: Supplier documentation approves an $8,400 credit, but no corresponding submitted credit or journal posting was found.
findings.action: Request issuance/posting of the approved $8,400 credit.

findings.title: Supplier credit not applied at settlement
findings.explanation: A $4,970 supplier credit existed before settlement, while the related $40,404 invoice was subsequently paid in full.

recovery_packages.subject: account reconciliation: A1
recovery_packages.body:
Hello,

During a reconciliation of our purchasing and supplier records, we identified a potential $12,240 exception related to supplier rebate shortfall.

Our supporting records are:
- Summit-Q1-2026-Rebate-Agreement.txt
- ACC-PINV-2026-00002
- ACC-PINV-2026-00005
- ACC-PINV-2026-00012
- ACC-PINV-2026-00013
- ACC-PINV-2026-00014
- ACC-PINV-2026-00015
- ACC-JV-2026-00001

Finding:
Q1 eligible spend reached the 6% rebate tier. Expected rebate was $36,720; only $24,480 was credited.

Could you review this against your records and confirm whether a credit or correction is due?

Thank you.

recovery_packages.subject: account reconciliation: A5
recovery_packages.body:
Hello,

During a reconciliation of our purchasing and supplier records, we identified a potential $4,970 exception related to supplier credit not applied at settlement.

Our supporting records are:
- ACC-JV-2026-00002
- ACC-PINV-2026-00006
- ACC-PAY-2026-00003

Finding:
A $4,970 supplier credit existed before settlement, while the related $40,404 invoice was subsequently paid in full.

Could you review this against your records and confirm whether a credit or correction is due?
